## Maintainer ruling recorded — B: retire `viewDescription` under enforce-or-remove; the authored `I18nLabel` value is the single channel

Director seat (objectstack #12708), summon #8, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #6 in which this card was item 2 with the recommendation B (fallback A; C not recommended). Verbatim reply: 「7205 B，其他同意」 — "其他同意" covers this card, so B is adopted as recommended.

**Ruled: B.** `useObjectLabel().viewDescription()` is removed from `@object-ui/i18n`, together with the `NS.objects.OBJECTNAME._views.VIEWNAME.description` catalog convention it resolved. A list view's description has exactly one channel: the authored `I18nLabel` value on the view entry (string or inline locale map), which #7199 already relays and resolves. Option A (wire the catalog key in and state a precedence rule) is not taken: two vocabularies for one concept plus a precedence rule is the ambiguity source, and the catalog channel has zero callers and zero in-repo bundle usage. Option C (leave it declared and unfulfilled) is not taken.

The pin tests in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-view.test.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.defaultViewIdentity.test.tsx` are retargeted: the surviving pins are that `viewLabel` and `viewEmptyState` still resolve, and that a `_views.VIEWNAME.description` catalog entry is inert (the authored value wins because it is the only reader). No deprecation window: the maintainer's standing rule is remove, not phase out, when a surface has measured zero use.

Execution: `domain:ui` lane, S. This removes a member from a published package's hook return type ⇒ **Clause-② yes**: the PR carries a `@object-ui/i18n` changeset (minor, "removed `viewDescription`; use the view entry's authored `description`") and is dispatched at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Out-of-repo translation bundles that authored the key cannot be seen from here; the changeset text is the notice.

State transition, same stroke: this card was carrying both `pm:queue` and `needs-user-decision` at once, which the state machine forbids; corrected to `pm:queue` only. `priority:p3` retained. Ledger: objectstack director seat post #12708, summon #8.

## Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat

Session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Branch `claude/issue-7219-retire-viewdescription`. Dispatching now.

Authority is the ruling in [5508044124](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7219#issuecomment-5508044124) (summon #8, decision batch #6, maintainer verbatim 「7205 B，其他同意」) — **option B, retire**.

⚠️ **This card reads as undecided and is not.** Its body says *"the correct resolution is a decision, not a mechanical fix"* and offers two dispositions. It was ruled. That makes seven cards in this lane ruled-in-comments while the body says otherwise (#7143 · #7282 · #5872 · #7155 · #6650 · #4895 · #6942, now #7219). I came within one write of applying `pm:retriage` to a fully-decided card.

### ⚠️ The premise has drifted since filing — measured on current `main` `d6ceb8d29`

The body states: *"Zero production callers. Every other hit in that grep is `previewDescription`, an unrelated import-wizard key."* That second clause is **no longer true**. `git grep viewDescription` now also returns three hits that are neither the hook member nor `previewDescription`:

```
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:3106   const viewDescription = pickLocalized(schema.description…)
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:3128   {viewDescription && (schema.appearance?.showDescription…
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:3130   {viewDescription}
```

These are a **local variable** of the same name, landed by #7199 — the *authored* `I18nLabel` channel. ⭐ They are precisely what the ruling **preserves**: *"the authored value wins because it is the only reader."*

⇒ The card's core claim (zero production callers of `useObjectLabel().viewDescription()`) still holds, and the retirement is still correct. But a dev grepping the symbol would meet three live hits that must **not** be touched. Carried into the dispatch brief as a named trap.

### File surface, checked against every open PR branch

Targets: `packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts`, `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-view.test.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.defaultViewIdentity.test.tsx`.

**Zero collisions** across #7332 (88 files), #7432 (23), #7442 (8), #7445 (17), #7447 (4), #7427 (20), #7422 (2), #7391 (33), #7400 (13) — each branch's total file count is non-zero, so the zero-collision reading is an instrument that fires.

⚠️ Recorded for the brief: #7391 and #7400 each touch **10** files under `packages/i18n/` (locale packs). This card needs none — the ruling notes the catalog channel has zero in-repo bundle usage — so the locale packs are fenced off.

Clause ② **yes** (removes a member from a published package's hook return type). The PR carries `needs:contract-review`, stays draft, and ⛔ this seat will not self-review, enqueue or auto-merge it.

State transition, same stroke: `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, assignee set.

## ACCEPT — option B executed. Delivered as PR #7451, held for contract review.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Clause ② **yes**, so ⛔ this seat does not review, enqueue or auto-merge. `needs:contract-review` applied and read back; PR stays draft. Card stays `pm:dispatched`.

### The premise was re-measured, not carried over

Production callers of `useObjectLabel().viewDescription()` on the branch point: **0**. Control `git grep -l viewLabel` = **36 files**, so the instrument fires. The card's core claim holds and the retirement is correct.

### ⭐ The trap the dispatch flagged — cleared, and it was real

The card's *"every other hit is `previewDescription`"* clause went stale when #7199 landed. `ListView.tsx:3106/3128/3130` now hold a **same-named local** (`pickLocalized(schema.description, displayLocale)`) which is the authored `I18nLabel` channel the ruling **preserves**. Verified independently: `ListView.tsx` is **byte-identical to `main`**, all three survivors present, and no `plugin-list` file appears in the diff at all.

`viewSuffixes` was **measured rather than assumed**, which is what the brief asked: it is shared — `viewLabel` passes `'label'`, `viewEmptyState` passes `'emptyState.title'` / `'emptyState.message'`, and only the retired member passed `'description'`. So the builder stays untouched and only the `'description'` tail is gone. Retiring the helper along with its one caller would have broken two working siblings.

### ⭐⭐ A fourth file, declared — and it is invisible to the obvious search

`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx` pins the hook's member set as an **absolute count** and had to move **27 → 26**. The dev's own words on why the brief did not name it:

> it contains no occurrence of the symbol so a grep for `viewDescription` does not reach it — found by running the whole i18n suite

⇒ **This is the second instance of that exact shape in one shift.** On #6940 it was `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, whose `KnownDrift` ledger is compile-time enforced and fails on a *repair* as loudly as on new drift. Here it is a member-count pin. Both are census files that must move when the population moves, and **both are unreachable by a grep for the thing being changed** — which is precisely why my dispatch fences kept missing them.

The lesson, recorded so it outlives this card: ⛔ **a "do-not-touch" fence on a ledger, census or count pin is suspect.** The correct instrument is running the package's whole suite, not grepping the symbol. I have carried this into the lane patrol.

### Ablation — direction predicted before the run

The mutation is the interesting choice: **put the member back**, i.e. reconstruct the option-A world the ruling refused. Predicted 2 RED / 20 GREEN before running; got exactly that, with both failures reading `expected [objectLabel, …(26)] to not include viewDescription`, and `ObjectView.viewDescriptionRelay-7199.test.tsx` — the *authored* channel — fully green throughout. That green file is the control that matters: it proves the retirement removed the catalog channel without disturbing the one the ruling preserves.

A second, type-level leg caught `TS2578: Unused @ts-expect-error directive`, so the two `@ts-expect-error` pins on the removed return-type member are genuinely checked. Both edited test files were proven to be program inputs via `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles`, so "typecheck green" is a measurement of them rather than an exclusion.

Mutation proven on disk before each run (blob `0834ec2f` → `452ebac5`, anchored injected-text count 0 → 1, with the anchor asserting `count == 1` so a zero-hit edit aborts instead of passing silently); restores proven **by state** — blob equality against the non-empty HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty — never by exit code.

### One gate honestly declared NOT MEASURED

`check:readme-exports` exits 1 with *"its type entry ./dist/index.d.ts is not on disk — run pnpm build first"*. It needs a full repo build, which is CI's job; no README and no package export is in this diff. ⇒ Reported as neither green nor red rather than counted as a pass. That is the right call, and CI runs it in full regardless.
